results.evidence: The variant NM_001114753.3:c.1701del in ENG is a frameshift variant at codon 567 (position 567/658), predicted to cause loss of function; haploinsufficiency is an established disease mechanism for HHT type 1 caused by ENG.
results.reasoning: The ENG gene causes HHT via haploinsufficiency, and loss-of-function (frameshift) is a known disease mechanism. The variant causes a frameshift at codon 567, which is before codon 594—the NMD (nonsense-mediated decay) boundary—meaning this truncation is predicted to undergo NMD and lead to loss of normal protein. Per CSpec GN136 v1.1.0: Frameshift variants predicted to undergo NMD (codon ≤594) receive PVS1 at Very Strong strength.
